realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Chancellor
primary.description: The quiet spine behind institutions; translates vision into something that survives contact with reality.
primary.guiding_promise: I will hold the center so the whole does not fall apart.
primary.shadow_description: Mistakes holding the center for holding on too tightly, and resists any change the institution actually needs.

secondary.label: Architect
secondary.description: Designs systems meant to outlast the person who built them.
secondary.guiding_promise: I design what outlasts me — and that is enough.
secondary.shadow_description: Falls in love with the design and forgets the people who have to live inside it.

wheel.central_question: Should we hold the center steady, or abandon it for the frontier?

growth.label: Architect
growth.description: Designs systems meant to outlast the person who built them.
growth.guiding_promise: I design what outlasts me — and that is enough.
growth.shadow_description: Falls in love with the design and forgets the people who have to live inside it.

other_ally.label: Strategist
other_ally.description: Plays the long game; every move is calculated toward winning.
other_ally.guiding_promise: Every move I make today is setting up tomorrow's victory.
other_ally.shadow_description: Starts treating the people around them as pieces to be played, not ends in themselves.

quarter.label: Scout
quarter.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.
quarter.guiding_promise: I go first — so others know the way is possible.
quarter.shadow_description: Leaps first so often they stop checking whether anyone can actually follow.

opposite.label: Pathfinder
opposite.description: Pioneers toward new worlds; rejects comfort as a destination.
opposite.guiding_promise: I reject comfort as a destination — the frontier is where I belong.
opposite.shadow_description: Pushes so far past the frontier that no one is left who remembers why they went.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
